trigger: UE needs to update its registration with the network due to mobility or periodic timer expiry.
state: UE is registered with the network and needs to update its registration information.
causes: Case zm1: UE determines there is enough time to complete the procedure before the start of the unavailability period
Case zl: UE supports S1 mode and has not disabled its EUTRA capability
expected_outcomes: UE's registration is updated with the network.
AMF reallocation occurs and the new AMF starts an implementation specific timer for onboarding services when the UE is registered for onboarding services in SNPN.
UE considers itself registered for normal service if disaster roaming registration is rejected.
UE considers the previously received allowed NSSAI as valid if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message does not contain an allowed NSSAI and no new allowed NSSAI.
error_handling: If the UE is unable to store its 5GMM and 5GSM contexts, the UE triggers the deregistration procedure.
